items.title: Everyone gets their own Toskar
items.text: Sign in with a password, an invite link, or your company's sign-in. Each person's chats, memories, files, and automations stay their own, and roles decide who can do what.

items.title: Automations that start themselves
items.text: Run a task on a schedule, when files change, when a web page or feed updates, or when another service calls it, and chain one into the next.

items.title: Set it up by asking
items.text: Say "every morning at 8, check…" in a chat, and Toskar drafts the automation for you to confirm.

items.title: Chat can see
items.text: Attach a photo, screenshot, diagram, or short video and ask about it, with Gemma 3 and Qwen 2.5 VL in the catalog.

items.title: Connect a device with a code
items.text: Phones, tablets, and TVs connect with a 6-digit code, and traffic between your computers and devices is encrypted.

items.title: See where each model runs
items.text: Every running model says whether it's on the GPU, partly, or on the CPU, and Diagnostics lists what a graphics card still needs, with the fix.

items.title: The desktop app is Toskar Pro
items.text: Same app, new name: Toskar Pro is the computer that runs your AI, and Toskar on your phone, tablet, TV, and watch connects to it.
